title: Expanding WKSI Eligibility Act
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-12-02 || H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-07-16 -> Markup By 2025-07-22 -> Reported By 2025-09-08
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: This bill reduces the required aggregate market value of voting and non-voting common equity shares for an issuer of securities to qualify as a well-known seasoned issuer. A well-known seasoned issuer is allowed to make expedited public offerings of securities through automatic shelf registrations.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
